documents.title: Договор между СССР и Польской Народной Республикой о разграничении территориального моря, экономической зоны, зоны морского рыболовства и континентального шельфа в Балтийском море
documents.institution: United Nations Division for Ocean Affairs and the Law of the Sea / United Nations Treaty Series
documents.publicationCitation: United Nations registration I-57784; entry into force 13 March 1986. Russian treaty text corroborated by the Soviet/Russian legal-document corpus.
documents.notes: Article 1 supplies the coordinate-defined territorial-sea segment. Article 2 supplies the separate economic-zone/fisheries/continental-shelf line through points A-D. The two legal objects are stored in separate History Core tracks.

documents.title: Соглашение между правительствами Швеции, ПНР и СССР об общей точке разграничения их морских пространств в Балтийском море
documents.institution: United Nations Division for Ocean Affairs and the Law of the Sea
documents.publicationCitation: UN maritime delimitation treaty publication; agreement entered into force 10 May 1990.
documents.notes: Article 1 independently identifies point D of the 1985 Soviet-Polish line as 55°51′00″ N, 18°56′12″ E and establishes the later common tripoint. Used here as coordinate corroboration, not to retroactively replace the 1985 treaty.
